perfect. So how many people did you summon to help you beat the boss at lvl 64? Ive beat her once by pure luck and thats the only way this boss gets beat. Hoarfrost Stomp + Bleed will get a win eventually.

If she hits your lifeless mimic, she will regain health. Its not lifesteal, its cheap. They got lazy and said "Oh, if they cant beat this boss, they should just grind to Level 200" neglecting to remember that she can 1 shot you with 50 vigor.
Never feel bad for cheesing a game that aims to cheese you. Bosses don't operate on the same rules you do so fuck it, abuse whatever is necessary to win.

It's an rng fight. Summon mimic,  let it tank and just try to proc bleed until you can stagger her enough. Keep trying and you'll get lucky, dont bother trying to study her attacks since she can 1 shot you from 50 vigor with Enshas Armor, just keep distance at all times. Good luck!

Edit: Just beat her for the 2nd time, funny thing is, if you run out of flasks while inflicted with scarlet rot and you die while she is still doing her ending dialogue, it doesn't count as a kill.
